title: F09: Potential-leak detection + insight cards, demo seed data
milestone: M5 API + UI
labels: frontend, backend
---
## Goal
Scenario 3: flag where spending may be leaking out of the budget and explain each potential leak on an insight card. The UI always says "potential leak", never "leak" (decision 0023); code and contract names keep `leak`. The motivating case: 50 € set for eating out, and 89 % of it spent before the middle of the month.

**Depends on:** F08
**Built by:** `backend-dev` ∥ `frontend-dev` (no contract change, so they can run in parallel)

## Scope
- Three leak types, with the rules and thresholds in decision 0023: `over_budget`, `on_pace_to_overrun` (early burn: at least 80 % of a budget used while at most 50 % of the current month has passed) and `spike` (more than 1.5 × the median of the previous 3 months).
- Out of scope, as future work: `small_frequent` and `recurring`. They stay in the contract's enum and are never returned.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `domain/leaks.py` implements 0023 as a pure module, with table-driven tests for each rule and its edges: exactly 80 %, exactly half the month (day 15 of 30/31, day 14 of 28), spend exactly at the budget, over the budget (over_budget only, no burn), no budget, a past month (no burn), fewer than 2 history months (no spike), median 0, and deposit/discount/uncategorised items left out
- [ ] Named test for the motivating case: budget 50,00 €, 44,50 € in 6 eating-out visits by 14 Oct → one `on_pace_to_overrun` leak, `amount` 48,54, run-out day 16.10.2026, and the explanation from 0023 word for word
- [ ] `GET /insights/leaks` replaces the F09 stub, with the same `?month=` handling as the summary, and has API tests (default month, a past month, an empty database → `[]`, `422` for a bad month)
- [ ] One new repository query for the visits per category (confirmed expenses with at least one item in the category, in a date range); the spike history reuses `confirmed_spend_by_category`
- [ ] The domain's category labels equal `CATEGORY_LABELS` in `frontend/js/categories.js` (test)
- [ ] Dashboard potential-leak cards as described in `frontend/pages.md` (Potential-leak cards): a "Potential leaks" section, server order, icon + words, `explanation` via `textContent`, an empty state, and a failed leaks request that doesn't break the rest of the page
- [ ] A static test checks that no user-visible string in the dashboard says "leak" without "potential"
- [ ] Demo seed: an `eating_out` budget of 50 € and front-loaded eating-out spend, so the burn card shows on **every day of the first half** of the current month; electronics stays `over_budget` on every day; a category with a `spike` against the two previous months on every day. A test checks every day of several months (28-, 30- and 31-day), as in F08. The F08 seed guarantees (electronics over, health on pace, goal card) still hold.
- [ ] `make check` passes; the reviewer agent and `/code-review` have run; the student has checked scenario 3 on the seeded data by hand
